hypotheses: V is an elementary abelian 2-group with an S_r action
nonzero z fixed by the point stabilizer of 1
declarations.conclusion: The displayed r marks form a string C-group on V_z semidirect S_r, without orbit-vector independence.
argument_checks: Any two transporters of 1 to j differ by a point stabilizer on the right, so z_j is well-defined and pi*z_j=z_(pi*j).
V_z is generated by the conjugates of z; every mark is a nonidentity involution and all nonadjacent pairs commute.
The Young subgroup generated by E is the product on individual path components, not the setwise stabilizer that could permute components.
For a mark subset D, the exact generated subgroup is W_D semidirect P_E: W_D is P_E-invariant and contains exactly the orbit span of z, while the generators include the full complement P_E.
The component containing 1 is an initial interval. Intersections of two component partitions equal the partition for E intersect F.
Initial spans are nested even with arbitrary linear dependencies; hence the vector intersection and permutation intersection both have the exact common-support value.
Cartesian coordinates in the same ambient semidirect product give every subset intersection, including empty sets and missing mark0.

hypotheses: Q acts on an abelian group V
declarations.conclusion: (v,g)->(v+c(g),g) is an automorphism with inverse from -c, fixing V and transporting marked IP.
argument_checks: Direct semidirect multiplication gives the homomorphism identity.
Pointwise addition of -c is a two-sided inverse; generated-subgroup/intersection transport follows from bijectivity.
The characteristic-two involution conclusion does not assert nonidentity; the shear can be identity in small cases.

declarations.conclusion: All six lists satisfy full IP; odd third-seed relation is allowed.
argument_checks: The three seeds are nonzero for r>=2 and point-stabilizer-fixed.
The relation matrix for lambda+e_j has kernel zero when r is even, and the line generated by lambda when r is odd.
For odd r its image is exactly the even-coordinate-sum space by dimension and containment.
epsilon(pi)*lambda is a cocycle, a+pi*a is a coboundary, and adjacent swaps give lambda+e_i+e_(i+1).
The shear is on the full V semidirect S_r; it need not preserve the original named subgroup in the odd case. Only marked isomorphism onto its image is claimed.

finite_diagnostics.arbitrary_module_scope: Enumerates all invariant quotients of the permutation module in ranks2..5, excluding zero seed. Every cyclic module generated by such an orbit is a quotient of the permutation module; the finite checks are diagnostics, not the proof for arbitrary rank.
finite_diagnostics.diagram_scope: Literal vertical edge-label complements and horizontal edges checked in ranks2..12; cocycle all permutation pairs in ranks2..5.
